extraction_notes: Main-text catalytic-performance plots are in Figure 5. Figures 1–3 are DFT/mechanistic calculations and Figure 6 is characterization/DRIFTS, so they were not digitised as measured catalytic performance. The Figure 5A inset reports normalized activity in arbitrary units and was not extracted because it is not conversion, selectivity, or methanol STY/formation rate. Standard-condition H2/CO2 is given as feed composition H2/CO2/N2 = 73/24/3 rather than a single printed H2/CO2 number; for Figure 5D the x-axis H2/CO2 ratios were recorded directly.
